# Indikator 3

**Indikator 3** is a clinical quality indicator managed by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] that measures the proportion of ADHD assessment processes in which a diagnostic conference involving a specialist in child and adolescent psychiatry is held within 120 days of the assessment's initiation [^src1]. The indicator is designed to ensure rigorous, interdisciplinary professional evaluation during the diagnostic phase, aligning with the [[dmpg-retningslinje|DMPG guidelines for ADHD assessment]] [^src6]. However, its performance has highlighted a systemic crisis in Danish child and adolescent psychiatry, revealing a severe lack of standardized diagnostic procedures and interdisciplinary collaboration [^src3].

Since its implementation in 2013, Indikator 3 has struggled to meet its national quality standard of ≥ 90% [^src3]. In fact, no regions or departments have successfully met this standard in recent reporting periods [^src3]. For the 2023/24 period (April 1, 2023, to March 31, 2024), the national compliance rate was a mere 21% [^src1]. Regional disparities were stark, with compliance ranging from 10% in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] to 34% in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src3]. At the departmental level, performance was equally poor; for instance, [[vejle-bup-ambulatorium|Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] recorded a 0% compliance rate (0 out of 406 processes), and Aabenraa recorded just 5% [^src2]. Furthermore, [[privathospitaler|private hospitals]] failed to meet the indicator in any of their registered cases [^src6]. The low compliance is largely attributed to conferences being held after the 120-day deadline and systemic issues with clinical registration practices [^src3].

In the subsequent 2024/25 reporting period (April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025), national compliance saw a slight improvement, reaching 27%, though this remains far below the 90% development target [^src5]. This modest national increase was primarily driven by significant improvements in specific regions, notably [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], which achieved a 51% compliance rate (a 32-percentage-point increase from the previous year), and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], which rose from 16% to 26% [^src6]. 

Recognizing the critical shortcomings of this indicator, the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Committee) has designated Indikator 3 as a primary focus area for the coming year [^src5]. This strategic attention is motivated by rising patient volumes, a shortage of [[speciallaeger|specialists]], and recent legislative changes that permit [[specialpsykolog|specialist psychologists]] to independently make diagnoses, necessitating a reevaluation of how diagnostic conferences are structured and recorded [^src5].

## Timeline

- 01.04.2023 - 31.03.2024: Opgørelsesperioden for Indikator 3, hvori resultaterne for 2023/24 er beregnet (indikator-3)
- 2013: Indikator 3 blev sat i drift (indikator-3)
- 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025: Opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 2b og Indikator 3 (indikator-2b, indikator-3)
- 2023/24: Forrige opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 2b og Indikator 3 (indikator-2b, indikator-3)
- 2022/23: Opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 2b og Indikator 3 to år tidligere (indikator-2b, indikator-3)
